title: Auto heal — params
description: Health check fails (consecutively) or error rate over X % for M minutes: restart the instance, or move it to another GPU/node. Applies to always_on models too (healing never reduces capacity).

health_failures.title: Consecutive health failures
health_failures.description: instances.health = unhealthy for this many consecutive agent health checks. null disables.

min_requests_in_window.title: Min requests in window
min_requests_in_window.description: Error rate is ignored when fewer requests were seen.

max_restarts_per_hour.title: Max restarts per hour
max_restarts_per_hour.description: After this many restarts of the same instance within an hour, restart_then_move escalates to move; move/restart stop and raise a critical alert.

exclude_failed_device.title: Avoid the same device when moving
